days.title: Peaks and Villages of San Emiliano
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Peña Ubiña
stops.detail: Under the watch of the immense rocky mass of Peña Ubiña (2417 m), the steep mountainous landscape of the San Emiliano valley unfolds.

stops.name: valle de San Emiliano
stops.detail: The San Emiliano valley preserves interesting rural centers.

stops.name: Riolago de Babia
stops.detail: Among them, the complex of Riolago de Babia stands out, with its Renaissance palace of the Quiñones and its sober walled enclosure.

days.title: Reservoirs and Groves of Luna
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Mirantes de Luna
stops.detail: Among the present vegetation, the masses of beech, oak, and the relic juniper grove —the westernmost in the Iberian Peninsula— of Mirantes de Luna stand out.

stops.name: embalse de Barrios de Luna
stops.detail: The presence of the Barrios de Luna reservoir allows for the existence of more or less numerous populations of aquatic birds (Anatidae, Rallidae, Ardeidae, etc.).

stops.name: puerto de Ventana
stops.detail: From Asturias, it is also accessed via the Trubia-Puente Orugo road, through the Ventana pass.

stops.name: Irede de Luna
stops.detail: Take this road and then continue on the one that leads to Irede de Luna.
